pr_body: Replaces the superseded pre-protocol Draft PR #71 on the current main baseline. This validated staged slice restores the ADR 0122 ECS listener/emitter synchronization and adds authoring-facing spatial options without changing stable component IDs. Audio emitter/listener schemas advance to version 2 with linear/inverse rolloff, looping, and listener priority defaults; existing AudioEmitter::new behavior remains linear and non-looping; runtime listener selection prefers the greatest priority with deterministic Entity fallback; and authored autoplay uses the selected rolloff and loop policy. Shared scene-level warning diagnostics and Project Rust spatial playback remain in following validated slices.
